hook.text: That red badge on your app icon isn't random. Red triggers urgency in the brain. It demands attention.

buildup.text: Notifications hijack your focus. Each ping pulls you from deep work. It takes 23 minutes to refocus after.

discovery.text: Platforms batch good notifications. They hold likes, then release them in clusters to bring you back.

twist.text: Some notifications have no content: 'See what you missed!' The curiosity gap is the entire strategy.

climax.text: Tristan Harris compared notifications to slot machines. Every buzz might be important—so you always check.

punchline.text: Notifications don't inform you. They summon you.

quiz.question: Why do platforms batch notifications?
options: To cluster rewards and draw users back
